# Agent — Relay package engineering contract

Identity entry: Agent. Agent Relay preserves authorized work independently of a model or provider.
Use the current owner's task; do not create or replace mission authority from a narrative summary.

Install via `INSTALL_FOR_CODING_AGENT.md`. Never touch another Relay store, modify an existing agent
identity, switch a repository branch or auto-migrate user state as part of installation.

The runtime is deterministic and has no model dependency. All model/tool-provider integrations are
explicit clients; provider names label attempts, not durable task ownership. Do not add another model
tier or silently replace an existing execution gateway.

Keep all original requirements and contract IDs. Use generated test results, never hand-edited PASS.
Do not edit an oracle to make a failing implementation appear valid. Preserve late receipts, unknown
effects, historical test results, and revision-bound context. Never retry UNKNOWN writes blindly.

Trusted local/remote workers with one authority are the current boundary; do not call it a hostile-code sandbox.
Do not promise all 46 contracts, real-provider compaction, automatic Git promotion, hardware power-loss,
active-active control or legacy migration without their actual implementation and evidence.
